episodes.title: The Psychology of Cults and The Truth Behind Conspiracy Theories (Feat. Jeremy Moody) - EP 103
episodes.description:
This week, Danii and Will sit down with writer, storyteller, comedian, and cult scholar Jeremy Moody to explore everything from conspiracy theories and hypnotism to cults, social media manipulation, and why people believe what they believe. Jeremy shares his thoughts on the Salem Witch Trials, Jonestown, the “Birds Aren’t Real” conspiracy, and his theory of “The Magician’s Dilemma.”

They also talk about moving from the East Coast to LA, why LA owes you nothing, media literacy, outrage-driven social media, and what went wrong with the marketing behind the D.A.R.E. program.
